mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST Q ON Q.ID=C.REQUEST_ID WHERE C.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND C.BINDING_REVISION >= 0 AND Q.STATUS!='CONVERGED'
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET SET STATE='CONFIRMED',CONFIRMED_AT=#{now},UPDATE_TIME=#{now},LEASE_TOKEN=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=NULL WHERE ID=#{targetId} AND OPERATION_VERSION=#{version} AND STATE IN ('QUEUED','EXECUTING','VERIFYING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND A.STATUS!='CLAIMED' AND (A.STATUS!='EXPIRED' OR A.ERROR_CODE IS NULL OR A.ERROR_CODE!='WAITING_RESOURCE_OWNER' OR A.TASK_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.DISPATCHED_AT IS NOT NULL OR A.RESULT_EVENT_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL OR A.CONVERGED_AT IS NOT NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM (SELECT E.ID FROM SMT_AUTH_RESULT_EVENT E JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C ON C.ATTEMPT_ID=E.ATTEMPT_ID AND C.TARGET_ID=E.TARGET_ID WHERE C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND C.RESOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation} AND C.BINDING_REVISION >= 0 AND E.CONVERGED='Y' AND E.OPERATION_VERSION=#{generation} AND E.EVENT_NAMESPACE LIKE 'WF:T:%' AND E.RESULT_STATUS='SUCCESS' AND E.EVIDENCE_TYPE IN ('DEVICE_ACK','DEVICE_QUERY') ORDER BY E.RECEIVED_AT DESC,E.ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM=1
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T SET STATE='CONVERGED',RESULT_SUMMARY=#{summary},CONVERGED_AT=#{now},UPDATE_TIME=#{now},LEASE_TOKEN=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=NULL WHERE T.ID=#{targetId} AND T.STATE IN ('QUEUED','EXECUTING','VERIFYING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND A.STATUS!='CLAIMED' AND (A.STATUS!='EXPIRED' OR A.ERROR_CODE IS NULL OR A.ERROR_CODE!='WAITING_RESOURCE_OWNER' OR A.TASK_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.DISPATCHED_AT IS NOT NULL OR A.RESULT_EVENT_ID IS NOT NULL OR A.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL OR A.CONVERGED_AT IS NOT NULL)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST Q ON Q.ID=C.REQUEST_ID WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.BINDING_REVISION >= 0 AND Q.STATUS!='CONVERGED')

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T SET STATE='CONVERGED',CONVERGED_AT=#{now},UPDATE_TIME=#{now} WHERE T.ID=#{targetId} AND T.STATE='CONFIRMED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.BINDING_REVISION >= 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST Q ON Q.ID=C.REQUEST_ID WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.BINDING_REVISION >= 0 AND Q.STATUS!='CONVERGED')

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH B SET STATUS='CONVERGED',CONVERGED_AT=#{now},FINISHED_AT=#{now},UPDATE_TIME=#{now} WHERE B.ID=#{batchId} AND B.STATUS NOT IN ('PREPARING','CONVERGED') AND B.EXPECTED_COUNT > 0 AND B.EXPANDED_COUNT=B.EXPECTED_COUNT AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.BATCH_ID=B.ID AND T.STATE!='CONVERGED')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD S ON S.ID=C.SOURCE_COORD_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_RESOURCE_COORD R ON R.ID=C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST Q ON Q.ID=C.REQUEST_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH B ON B.ID=Q.BATCH_ID WHERE R.ID=#{resourceId} AND R.GENERATION=#{generation} AND C.RESOURCE_GENERATION=R.GENERATION AND C.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND C.SOURCE_GENERATION=S.GENERATION AND (C.SOURCE_ROW_ID=S.SOURCE_ROW_ID OR (C.SOURCE_ROW_ID IS NULL AND S.SOURCE_ROW_ID IS NULL)) AND C.SOURCE_FINGERPRINT=S.SOURCE_FINGERPRINT AND Q.SOURCE_IDENTITY_KEY=S.ID AND Q.GENERATION=S.GENERATION AND Q.PARK_ID=R.PARK_ID AND B.PARK_ID=R.PARK_ID AND S.PARK_ID=R.PARK_ID AND S.SUBJECT_TYPE=R.SUBJECT_TYPE AND S.SUBJECT_ID=R.SUBJECT_ID AND Q.SUBJECT_TYPE=S.SUBJECT_TYPE AND B.STATUS NOT IN ('CONVERGED','FAILED') AND Q.STATUS!='CONVERGED' AND ((B.STATUS='PREPARING' AND C.TARGET_ID IS NULL AND S.BATCH_ID=B.ID AND S.STATE IN ('EXPANDING','REVOKING','ACTIVE')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.ID=C.TARGET_ID AND T.BATCH_ID=B.ID AND T.PARK_ID=R.PARK_ID AND T.SUBJECT_TYPE=R.SUBJECT_TYPE AND T.SUBJECT_ID=R.SUBJECT_ID AND T.DEVICE_ID=R.DEVICE_ID AND T.ACCESS_TYPE=R.ACCESS_TYPE AND T.RESOURCE_TYPE=R.RESOURCE_TYPE AND T.OPERATION_VERSION=R.GENERATION AND T.ACTION=R.ACTION AND T.STATE IN ('PREPARING','QUEUED','EXECUTING','VERIFYING','WAITING_CONFIRM','CONFIRMED')))

SELECT * FROM (SELECT C.* FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD S ON S.ID=C.SOURCE_COORD_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_RESOURCE_COORD R ON R.ID=C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID WHERE S.PARK_ID=#{park} AND C.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND C.SOURCE_GENERATION=S.GENERATION AND ((C.RESOURCE_GENERATION < R.GENERATION AND C.TARGET_ID IS NOT NULL) OR (C.TARGET_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE H WHERE H.SOURCE_COORD_ID=C.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND H.SOURCE_GENERATION=C.SOURCE_GENERATION AND H.RESOURCE_COORD_ID=C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID AND H.BINDING_REVISION > 0))) AND C.ID > #{after} ORDER BY C.ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
